content.summary: Recommend a bounded timeline prototype while owner selection remains pending.
content.question: Which structural direction should proceed to system resolution?
alternatives: Hybrid timeline and queue with shared incident context
content.rationale: Timeline makes ownership explicit; queue may fit high handoff volume. The hybrid needs a continuity check and none is adopted automatically.

provenance.rationale: Sources are per-target evaluations; the owner makes the durable choice at the Human Commit Point.
